requirements.description: I/B/E/S detailed U.S. target-price forecast observations: target price, forecast horizon, analyst identifier, firm identifiers and the announcement/release date, including prior semiannual measurement cohorts needed for LagTPPERF.

required_coverage.frequency: individual forecast event; daily announcement dates
required_coverage.population: U.S. listed firms with identifiable I/B/E/S target-price analysts; target-price issues in 2000–2009 plus the prior measurement cohort
required_coverage.detail: The current target-price release sample is Jan 2000–Dec 2009; an earlier semiannual cohort is needed for LagTPPERF. This bounds forecast issue dates at 1999–2009; price realization horizons are a separate CRSP requirement through 2010.

routes.mapping_notes: PTGDET is the candidate split-adjusted target-price detail product: ANNDATS/ACTDATS date the record, HORIZON supports 12-month screening, VALUE is the target price, AMASKCD/ESTIMID identify contributors, and TICKER/CUSIP identify issuers. PTGDETU is a distinct cataloged unadjusted product. The local catalog/probe does not establish adjusted-product semantics, analyst identifiability, or valid historical linkage to CRSP.
routes.coverage_notes: The successful one-row probe confirms readability and fields only. No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation supplies required years, population and frequency; local coverage remains unverified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Local field presence is verified, but the local snapshot has no supplied historical/population coverage confirmation and the split-adjusted product, analyst coding and historical firm mapping have not been independently verified.

requirements.description: Daily CRSP stock prices, returns, shares and split adjustment data for calculating pre-release closing prices, P12 horizon prices, target-price met outcomes, six-month momentum, one-year price variability and market capitalization.

required_coverage.population: U.S. common stocks linked to the I/B/E/S target-price sample; daily history for pre-release lookbacks and 12-month forecast horizons
required_coverage.detail: Current event years 2000–2009; include one-year lookback for STDPRC and 12-month lookahead for P12, plus the prior LagTPPERF cohort. The helper envelope for the release-date anchor 2000–2009 with 12-month lookback and 12-month lead is 1999–2010.

routes.mapping_notes: Daily CRSP security records are the candidate source for closing prices, returns, shares and cumulative split-adjustment factors. Use dates relative to target-price release, calculate price ratios after a consistent adjustment, and derive 6-month buy-and-hold raw return and 1-year standard deviation from daily observations. The probe proves fields, not split-adjustment conventions or matching coverage.
routes.coverage_notes: The successful one-row probe confirms readability and fields only. No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation supplies required years, population and frequency; local coverage remains unverified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The exact local table and fields are readable, but no supplied local coverage confirmation supports the sample security population and 1999–2010 daily history; exact price adjustment and dividend conventions remain to be verified.

requirements.description: Daily CRSP value-weighted market return series used for 12-month buy-and-hold MKTRET after each target-price release date.

required_coverage.population: CRSP U.S. value-weighted market index; rolling 12-month windows after target-price release dates
required_coverage.detail: The source requires a 12-month post-release return. Calendar release years 2000–2009 therefore require daily index observations through 2010; the paper does not specify whether to include dividends.

routes.mapping_notes: CRSP.DSI contains daily value-weighted return fields including (vwretd) and excluding (vwretx) dividends; either field can represent the index return series but the paper does not state the dividend convention. Buy-and-hold is formed over the 12 months after release.
routes.coverage_notes: The successful one-row probe confirms readability and fields only. No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation supplies required years, population and frequency; local coverage remains unverified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The exact local index table and fields are readable; local historical coverage has no coordinator confirmation, and the paper does not specify dividend inclusion for the value-weighted return.

requirements.description: Historical CRSP security names and CUSIP validity dates needed to associate firm identifiers with PERMNO and apply date-valid market-price observations.

required_coverage.frequency: effective-date intervals and daily security data
required_coverage.population: U.S. sample firms and CRSP securities with identifiers valid on the target-price release/price observation dates
required_coverage.detail: Use identifier records valid at each forecast/event date; matching current ticker alone is insufficient.

routes.mapping_notes: The names table supplies PERMNO, ticker/CUSIP identifiers and name-start/name-end dates. It can support historical CRSP-side resolution and SIC input, but does not itself supply an I/B/E/S crosswalk or prove the firms in the sample are covered.
routes.coverage_notes: The successful one-row probe confirms readability and fields only. No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation supplies required years, population and frequency; local coverage remains unverified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The CRSP-side identifiers and effective dates are present, but the paper does not state its IBES-to-CRSP linkage rule, and no valid-date crosswalk from IBES analyst/company records to CRSP PERMNO is supplied. Coverage is also unconfirmed.

requirements.description: Fama–French 48-industry assignment for sample firms to reproduce the reported industry fixed effects.

required_coverage.detail: Paper specifies Fama–French (1997) 48-industry classification; a current SIC field is only an input and does not itself reproduce the 48-bin mapping.

routes.mapping_notes: The local field provides SIC codes but not the Fama–French 48-category mapping. It is only an input candidate, so semantic mapping remains unverified until the exact classification table/source and code rules are verified.
routes.coverage_notes: The successful one-row probe confirms readability and fields only. No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation supplies required years, population and frequency; local coverage remains unverified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The local catalog has a CRSP SIC field but no verified Fama–French 48-industry mapping. The required industry categories cannot be reconstructed from SIC without that mapping.

requirements.description: Historical IBES-to-CRSP analyst/firm/security link, including date-valid issuer identity and analyst key needed to carry forecast events to CRSP prices and cluster by analyst.

required_coverage.population: U.S. target-price forecasts and CRSP securities/analysts in the event sample
required_coverage.detail: The historical identifier link must resolve target-price firm and analyst identities at each event date; cataloged identifiers on two products are not themselves proof of a correct join.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No supplied or probed date-valid IBES-to-CRSP crosswalk identifies the required security key and analyst identity. IBES and CRSP identifiers are present separately, but a join on a current ticker or an unverified CUSIP is not a supported link.

variable_coverage.construction: Construct the assigned performance outcome from current I/B/E/S target-price forecast values and release dates matched to CRSP daily prices. TPRANK is the within-analyst/half-year Spearman rank correlation between forecast return (TP−P)/P and realized price return (P12−P)/P; |TPERROR| is |(P12−TP)/P|; TPMETEND and TPMETANY are indicators against target price over the 12-month horizon. Use the source’s split-adjusted basis and preserve the outcome-specific measurement unit.

For each analyst and semiannual measurement period, compute the relevant target-price performance measure, rank analysts into quintiles, then normalize (quintile−1)/4 for the subsequent target-price performance observation. Source defines non-overlapping measurement/test periods; exact historical analyst/security linkage is unresolved.

design_coverage.reason: The paper specifies OLS for continuous target-price performance, logistic regression for indicator outcomes, an intercept, and analyst-clustered standard errors; the estimator itself needs no additional input data.
No weighting scheme is reported for these fits.

review_notes: All four assigned Table 5 baseline fits are retained. No local coverage confirmation is supplied, so readable fields do not establish the 1999–2010 event/security population. The source’s separate half-year TPRANK unit and target-price-level multivariate units are preserved.
